empty.text: Add the units you sell, buy and stock in.

modal.title: Unit {{code}}
modal.codeHint: A short code such as PCS or KG. Start with a letter; it cannot change after you save.
modal.displayNameHint: The main name shown when a language name is missing. Up to 160 characters.
modal.nameEnHint: Shown in the English interface. Up to 160 characters.
modal.nameArHint: Shown in the Arabic interface. Up to 160 characters.
modal.activeHint: Retired units stay on old records but cannot be chosen for new ones.
modal.activeHelp: Turn off to retire this unit.
modal.codePattern: Start with a letter; use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (up to 32).

retire.title: Retire “{{code}}”?
retire.text: It will no longer be offered for new items, prices or documents.

group.ITEM_BASE: items use it as their base unit

groupOne.ITEM_BASE: item uses it as its base unit

inUse.title: This unit is still in use
inUse.text: The unit cannot be retired while any of these use it:
inUse.reason2: A company's default sales or purchase unit for an item
inUse.reason4: An open quotation, order or draft invoice
inUse.note: The system does not say which one. Remove the unit from these records, then retire it again.
inUse.groupsNote: Remove the unit from these records, then retire it again.
